title: SRD 5.1 importer: condition parser
description:
**Prerequisites (apply to all SRD 5.1 importer child issues):**
- Vendored SRD 5.1 PDF must be in place at `packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf` — see that directory's README.md.
- Reference implementation: mirror the structure of `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseSpells.ts` (parser), `emit.ts` (record builder + manifest description), `index.ts` (pipeline wiring), and the test layout under `packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/`.
- Depends on `loreweaver-0m9.5.9` (section detection + orchestrator) — run parsers over narrowed page slices, not the full PDF.

---

Add a parser for SRD 5.1 conditions (kind=condition: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, incapacitated, invisible, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious). Each entry's body becomes the description; data carries the structured rule text.

Note: exhaustion is special — it has six numbered levels with cumulative effects. Either model as a single condition record whose data carries the level table, or as a separate exhaustion-levels table record (kind=table). Pick one; both are reasonable.
acceptance_criteria:
- Parser extracts every named SRD condition (15 standard conditions).
- Records satisfy dnd5e-srd condition baseline kindSchema.
- Exhaustion-level handling is implemented and the choice (single record vs. paired table) is documented in the parser file header.
- Manifest description includes 'condition' in Included record kinds.
- Unit tests cover a flat-effect condition (e.g. blinded), a level-bearing condition (exhaustion), and a condition with conditional effects (e.g. unconscious -> auto-fail dex/str saves, attacks against have advantage).
close_reason: Merged via PR #94 — condition parser + review fixes landed on main
